function.name: attribute_of_entity
function.description: Value(s) of ONE relation for ONE named entity (a single-hop fact lookup).

function.name: compare_attribute
function.description: The same attribute for TWO named entities, side by side; optionally via a bridge relation.

function.name: entities_with_relation_to
function.description: Entities that hold ONE relation pointing at a named entity (reverse lookup).

function.name: kin_of
function.description: A named person's relatives of ONE kinship type (father, mother, parent, child, spouse, sibling, grandparent, grandchild, uncle).

function.name: neighbors
function.description: Entities within `hops` (1-3) of ONE named entity, with the relation type of each direct neighbor.

function.name: passages_for_entity
function.description: Raw source passage text mentioning ONE named entity.

function.name: relation_between
function.description: Direct (1-hop) relation(s) between TWO named entities, either direction.

function.name: relation_chain
function.description: Two-hop chain from ONE named entity: entity -[relation1]- via -[relation2]- answer.

function.name: shortest_path_between
function.description: Shortest relation path between TWO named entities, via any intermediates.

function.name: triples_with_relation
function.description: All (subject, relation, object) triples for ONE relation type, optionally restricted to a subject.
